'''Zero Command''' was a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] that was formed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Admiral Blitzer Harrsk of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] took a task force to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], where he claimed a number of worlds around the world [[Kalist VI/Legends|Kalist VI]] and established a protectorate, which he named "Zero Command". Harrsk gave himself the title [[Lord High Admiral]] and made himself the leader of Zero Command. The [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] later expanded Zero Command and gained control of a number of worlds in the [[Southern Core]], including [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] and [[Belgaroth]].<ref name="TEA" />

When [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] returned from the dead in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body, Harrsk and Zero Command served him, but became independent once more after Palpatine was killed. Harrsk began a recruitment drive in the distant [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], bringing Zero Command into conflict with Imperial warlord [[Treuten Teradoc]],<ref name="TEA" /> one of the leaders of the [[Federated Teradoc Union]].<ref name="Despoilers">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> Zero Command was later [[Imperial Reunification|reunited]] with eleven other [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] holdings by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> to form the [[United Warlord Fleets]] and eventually the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Military==
Lord High Admiral Harrsk commanded a fleet of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], including the heavily modified [[Shockwave (Imperial-class)|''Shockwave'']].<ref name="Darksaber" /> He also controlled at least two [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyers]] and the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] ''[[Ilthmar's Fist]]''. In addition, at least two [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]], [[Dominion (Star Dreadnought)|''Dominion'']] and ''[[Megador]]'', were under going construction within [[Deep 3]], one of Harrsk's secret [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. At Deep 3, there were many robotic [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Mine/Legends|mines]], and caches of various weapons. These would later be recovered by Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] after the death of Harrsk.<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] made up a majority of the ground forces of the Zero Command.<ref name="Darksaber" />
